hero.tagline: Frontend-focused software developer building modern, scalable web interfaces — with complementary backend experience.

about.heading: About
about.body: I'm a software developer with over 2 years of professional experience, primarily focused on frontend development, with complementary backend and full-stack experience. I've worked on the development, maintenance, and evolution of web applications across enterprise projects and client-specific solutions. My experience centers on building modern, responsive, and scalable user interfaces using component-based architectures, REST API integration, and solid software engineering practices.

highlights: Designed, built, and maintained reusable, encapsulated web components under a component-based architecture, prioritizing modularity, reusability, and maintainability.
Built and maintained web components with Lit, leveraging reactive rendering and lightweight templates to ship efficient, reusable interfaces.
Wrote unit tests with Mocha, Sinon, and Open Web Components (open-wc), covering component behavior, business logic, events, and dependencies via mocks and stubs.
Implemented end-to-end tests with Cucumber to validate complete application flows against real user scenarios and business processes.
Applied strict code quality practices — ESLint, test coverage, low complexity, and consistent standards — to keep the codebase clean and scalable.
Translated functional requirements into technical solutions aligned with the client's business logic, ensuring components and flows supported the expected processes.
Supported and maintained software systems across frontend and backend environments, ensuring stability, performance, and continuous improvement.
Managed and optimized databases, focusing on indexing, query performance, data organization, and overall database efficiency.
Supported and enhanced an Angular 14 application — building new features, maintaining existing ones, fixing issues, and improving usability and performance.
Supported backend functionality built with .NET and ASP.NET Core, including APIs, business logic, data access, and integrations between frontend applications and backend services.
Provided technical support to clients by identifying, analyzing, and resolving platform issues, communicating with users to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solutions.
Implemented responsive, visually consistent interfaces from Figma designs with a pixel-perfect approach.
Contributed to the development and maintenance of multiple frontend software projects.
Built web applications with Angular 18 and 19, integrating services via GraphQL, styling with Sass, and reactive state management with RxJS.
Built interactive interfaces with React 18, using Framer Motion for animations, Tailwind CSS for styling, and analytics tooling to monitor user behavior.
Contributed to the backend with a Go-based WhatsApp chatbot prototype aimed at automating interactions and message processing.
Developed, customized, and maintained WordPress sites with functionality tailored to each project's requirements.
